Employee Learning Data Policy

Effective date: 1 August 2026  •  Version: 1.0

This policy explains exactly how SD Academy collects and uses your learning data.

1. Purpose of This Policy

This document explains in plain language what learning data SD Academy collects from you, who can see it, how it is used, how long it is kept, and what your rights are. It is intended to help you understand and trust the platform.

2. What Learning Data Is Collected

Data CategoryExamplesWhy It Is Collected
Course enrolmentCourses assigned to your profileTo deliver your learning path
Lesson progressPercentage watched / read per lessonTo track completion and resume learning
Assessment resultsScores, attempt count, date and timeTo validate competency and issue certificates
Assignment submissionsUploaded practical tasks, text responsesFor manager review and sign-off
SOP acknowledgmentsDate and version acknowledgedFor compliance and audit trail
CertificatesCourse name, date issued, certificate IDPermanent verification record
Login activityDate, time, device, IP addressSecurity and access audit
Support ticketsIssue described, messages exchangedTo resolve your support request

3. Who Can Access Your Learning Data

RoleWhat They Can See
You (the employee)All your own learning history, scores, certificates and progress
Reporting ManagerYour completion status, overdue learning, assignment submissions requiring sign-off, assessment scores (for managed team)
HR / L&D AdministratorFull learning records for all employees in their assigned company/department; completion reports; certificate registry
Group Super AdminSystem-wide reports; audit logs; administrator action logs
IT / System AdminSecurity logs only — no access to learning content or scores

4. Does My Score Affect My Appraisal or Promotion?

Completion of mandatory courses is a baseline employment requirement and will be visible to your manager and HR. The direct use of assessment scores in formal performance reviews or promotion decisions varies by company within the SD Group. This decision is made at the company HR policy level, not by SD Academy. Contact your HR team to understand the specific policy that applies to you.

SD Academy will never share your individual scores with anyone outside the SD Group or with third parties.

5. Data Retention Schedule

Data TypeRetention Period
Active employee learning recordsDuration of employment
Post-resignation records3 years after last working day
Certificate recordsPermanently archived (for verification)
Assessment attempt logs3 years
SOP acknowledgment records3 years
Support ticket records1 year after resolution
Login / security audit logs2 years
Intern / trainee records1 year after assignment end

6. When You Leave the Organisation

  • Your account is suspended on your last working day, as notified by HR
  • You will not be able to log in after that date
  • Your learning records are archived — not deleted — for the retention period specified above
  • Certificate verification remains available through SD Academy's certificate-verification service after resignation
  • You may request a copy of your learning history and certificates before your last working day by contacting support@sdacademy.co.in

7. How to Request a Data Correction

If you believe any learning data held about you is incorrect (e.g., a certificate was not issued after passing, or a score was recorded incorrectly), submit a support ticket via SD Academy or email support@sdacademy.co.in with the following information:

  • Your name and employee ID
  • The specific record you believe is incorrect
  • What the correct information should be
  • Any supporting evidence (e.g. screenshot of assessment completion)

Expected response time: 2 business days.

8. How to Raise a Data Complaint

If you have a complaint about how your learning data is being used, you may:

  1. Raise a support ticket within SD Academy
  2. Contact your company HR representative directly
  3. Email support@sdacademy.co.in with "Data Complaint" in the subject line

All complaints will be acknowledged within 2 business days and resolved within 10 business days.
